propsVocabulary.label: trigger-mode label text, in the `.pc-sidebar__label` span. svelte `labelText`, keen `label`. Default "Search…".
propsVocabulary.action: set it to switch to TYPE-AND-GO form mode (`.pc-sidebar__search--input`) — a <form> whose native GET submit navigates to a results page on Enter. svelte `action`, keen `action`. Absent → the trigger button.
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim to the mode root (the trigger <button> or the <form>) after `pc-sidebar__search` (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough; not a core modifier.

goldenConventions: Goldens encode BOTH shared modes and the a11y conventions the oracle snippet blesses: the TRIGGER button carries NO aria-label (the visible `.pc-sidebar__label` is the name); the TYPE-AND-GO form's submit magnifier + input both carry aria-label="Search"; the input emits no `value` attribute when empty. method defaults to "get", name to "q", placeholder to "Search…" — all matching both wrappers. The custom `icon` slot is defaulted (trigger uses the masked `.pa-icon.pa-icon--search`; the form magnifier is empty, core masks it). Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away.
